description: The file defines a class 'ElasticSearchCommands' extending Robo Tasks, providing command-line interfaces for performing Elasticsearch search, indexing, and index removal within a SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for executing searches with query string syntax, indexing the database (full or differential), and deleting the Elasticsearch index, along with auxiliary methods for displaying results.

classes.name: ElasticSearchCommands
classes.description: A command class providing CLI commands for searching, indexing, and deleting Elasticsearch indices within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: elasticSearch
methods.description: Performs a search on Elasticsearch using the specified query, displaying results and search time.

methods.name: elasticIndex
methods.description: Indexes the database into Elasticsearch, either fully or differential, based on parameters.

methods.name: printModuleResults
methods.description: Displays search results for each module, either as raw JSON or as module names.

methods.name: showSearchTime
methods.description: Displays the time taken to perform the search.
